title: MM-GRADE - multi-modal RAG system for EDA tool documentation QA with vision LLM finetuning
problem: EDA tool documentation is complex and scattered across multiple formats (text, diagrams, screenshots). Users struggle to find accurate answers to technical questions about tool usage and configuration.
motivation: A multi-modal RAG system combining text and vision understanding can effectively search and synthesize answers from heterogeneous documentation formats, reducing user query resolution time.
method: MM-GRADE integrates retrieval-augmented generation with vision LLM finetuning to process both textual documentation and visual materials (diagrams, screenshots), retrieving relevant multi-modal content and generating comprehensive answers through an LLM.
key_novelty: Multi-modal RAG approach combining vision LLM finetuning for EDA tool documentation QA, enabling semantic search across mixed content types.
contributions: Multi-modal RAG framework for technical documentation QA
Vision LLM finetuning methodology for diagram and screenshot understanding
Improved answer accuracy and relevance for EDA tool queries
limitations: Performance metrics and evaluation against existing documentation systems are not specified, limiting assessment of practical improvements.
